tasks.short: Coordinate the closing checklist, attend the signing, leave disbursement to the notary.

steps.what: Coordinate property closings by listing the documents still open.

loop.output: Open documents, parties, price and dates
loop.check: Agent deletes a row the agreement does not support
loop.why_not_simpler: Free-text conditions do not map to a fixed row

steps.what: Send the closing reminder once the checklist version is approved.
Chase missing documents before the signing appointment.
Attend the signing, overseeing the documents before funds move.
Complete disbursement of the funds. This is the notary's act.
Store the signed documents on the property file.

tasks.design: The {CRM} agreement feeds a closing checklist. Reminders go out only on the version the agent checked. The agent still chases gaps and attends the signing. Disbursement stays with the notary.
tasks.previous_blocker: The checklist lived in a mailbox thread, so a missing page showed up at the table.
tasks.enabler_now: Parties, price and dates are already fields. A date rule can send a reminder. The signing cannot.
tasks.still_hard: Seeing, in the room, that a page on the table is not the page that was checked.
tasks.human_edge: The agent stops a signing when a document does not match the checklist.

ambition.what: Each open document is marked held, waived or blocking before the signing day.

tasks.altitude: The agent still attends every signing and can refuse to treat a waiver as granted. The chase list is no longer rebuilt by hand.

reach.task: Set which missing document the agency may waive
reach.learn: Which gaps the broker will not let an agent waive alone

evidence.claim: A purchase agreement filled from the client record gives the checklist the parties and the price.
Date reminders are ordinary rules on fields that already exist.
Sales agents fall under anti-money-laundering duties when client funds are involved.

assumptions: Focal role is the sales agent. Boundary: from an agreed purchase to a filed signing pack. Drawing the deed and moving the funds are the notary's work, counted as supplier time, not as time the agent saves.
Fields: party names, price, signing date, and the document names the agreement already lists. The agent produces a waiver note. Fallback: leave the row open.
Use the agreement already in {CRM} before a new store. Runtime of the reminder is not agent time.
Upkeep of 4 hours covers checklist rows. The prior that this task is coordination matches the design: the agent still attends.
unknowns: Whether the notary already shares a portal date.
Which documents the agency allows an agent to waive.
research_questions: How often does a document still arrive for the first time at the signing?

incremental.description: Keep checklist rows aligned with the documents the notary requires

approvals.approved_version: closing checklist version the agent checked

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: nonstandard deals make the checklist wrong, so the chase and the signing stay at full length. High: standard files remind themselves and the agent still attends. Notary time is not saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Read a market brief, then attend the seminars and staff meetings.

steps.what: Pull recent property listings into a short market brief.
Mark which trade journals change the local price view.

loop.output: A claim and its source line
loop.check: Drop a claim with no source line
loop.why_not_simpler: A column of new listings cannot read an argument

steps.what: Attend conventions and seminars and write notes by hand.
Join staff meetings and name what the brief missed.
Write three points on local markets the agent will reuse.

loop.check: Each sentence cites a listing row or a note
loop.why_not_simpler: The agent still chooses which point matters

tasks.design: A {BI} brief lists new listings before the week starts. The agent still reads journals, attends seminars and speaks in the staff meeting. Three reusable points are drafted from notes the agent made.
tasks.previous_blocker: Staying current meant a pile of unread mail and whatever a colleague remembered.
tasks.enabler_now: New listings are already rows. A brief can list them. A seminar cannot be attended by a brief.
tasks.still_hard: Hearing a market shift that is not in this week's listings.
tasks.human_edge: The agent decides which point will change how they advise next week.

ambition.what: Once a week the agent keeps or drops three market points, instead of hoping the reading stuck.

tasks.altitude: Seminars and staff meetings stay on the week. The agent can ignore a brief that only repeats last week.

reach.task: Choose which market points the office treats as shared
reach.learn: Which points the broker wants every agent to be able to explain

evidence.claim: Listing rows can be grouped into a brief. Attending a seminar stays with the person.

assumptions: Focal role is the sales agent. Boundary: from new listings and saved reading to three points the agent will reuse. Colleagues' time in the meeting is outside this task.
Fields: listing date, place, asking price, status. The agent produces the three points. Fallback: an empty brief.
Use the listing extract already in {BI} before a new feed. Runtime is not agent time.
Upkeep of 3 hours covers brief headings. The class says amplify: the brief helps, the attendance stays.
unknowns: Which journals the office already pays for.
Whether staff meetings have a fixed slot.
research_questions: What share of the three points is still cited a month later?

incremental.description: Retire brief headings that nobody cites

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the week is the seminars and the meeting, and the brief is ignored. High: the brief replaces the hunt through listings, and attendance stays.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Answer known questions from an approved card and talk through the rest.

steps.what: Match clients questions to an approved card on repairs.

loop.input: The question text and the approved cards
loop.check: A card is used only if its words cover the question
loop.why_not_simpler: A card library is not advice

steps.what: Decide whether financing or appraisals need another profession.
Answer clients on construction, maintenance, and the financing gap.
Send the written answer the agent has accepted.

tasks.design: An approved card is offered when the question is one the office has already answered. The agent decides when the question needs a lender, a builder or an appraiser, and gives the answer in the conversation. A written reply goes out only after that.
tasks.previous_blocker: Answers were retyped from memory, and a financing question was sometimes answered by the agent.
tasks.enabler_now: Repeated repair questions can sit on cards. Financing advice and appraisal judgement cannot.
tasks.still_hard: Hearing that the question is really about a defect the client has not named.
tasks.human_edge: The agent knows when to stop and send the client to someone who may advise.

ambition.what: No new service. Known answers are reused so the conversation can stay on the hard question.

tasks.altitude: The conversation stays. The agent can refuse to send a card they have not accepted, and can refuse a financing answer that is not theirs to give.

reach.task: Hear a defect question that is really about cover
reach.learn: Which questions must be passed to someone allowed to advise

evidence.claim: A library of approved answers can draft a known reply. The conversation and any financing judgement stay with a person.
National rules decide who may advise on a mortgage or an appraisal. This design does not give that advice.

assumptions: Focal role is the sales agent. Boundary: from a client question to a spoken answer and, when needed, a written reply. The office's card library is the source. Fallback: no card, the agent answers from knowledge.
Cards hold repairs, ordinary maintenance and construction terms the office has approved. They do not hold a rate or a value. The agent produces the routing decision.
Configure the card list in {DOCS} before a new tool. Upkeep of 3 hours is the card review.
The class says amplify. The design agrees the talk stays, and disagrees with any reading that a card may recommend financing.
unknowns: Whether the office already has an approved answer set.
Which questions clients send in writing.
research_questions: What share of questions match a card the agent accepts unchanged?

incremental.description: Review answer cards when building practice or the law changes

approvals.approved_version: answer card version the agent accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: almost every question is new, so the card is unused and the conversation stays. High: repeated repair questions reuse a card, and financing questions still take the conversation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Show the property and explain the features the client is standing in.

steps.what: Load features before the display of these properties.
Check industrial or agricultural features against the property.
Display the properties and explain their features to clients.
Note which features the clients asked about on site.
Write the visit note from features the clients named.

loop.check: Every feature in the note was named on site
loop.why_not_simpler: A listing sheet is not what the client reacted to

tasks.design: A feature sheet is loaded from the listing before the visit. The agent corrects it, then displays the property and explains it in person. The note afterwards uses only features the client asked about.
tasks.previous_blocker: Feature sheets were copied forward, including uses the building does not have.
tasks.enabler_now: Listed features are fields. Standing in the building and explaining it is not.
tasks.still_hard: Noticing a feature the sheet omits, or a feature the sheet invents.
tasks.human_edge: The agent will not describe a use the client cannot see.

ambition.what: No new service. The showing stays, with a sheet that matches the building.

tasks.altitude: Showings stay on the week. The agent can refuse a sheet that names an industrial or agricultural use the building does not have.

reach.task: Set which uses a feature sheet may claim
reach.learn: Which claims the broker will not let a sheet carry

evidence.claim: A listing can show its stored features. Explaining them on site stays with the agent.

assumptions: Focal role is the sales agent. Boundary: from a listing record to a visit note after the showing. Photos are the real photos on the listing. This task does not restyle them.
Fields: use type, floor area, and the feature names already stored. The agent produces corrections. Fallback: a blank sheet.
Configure listing fields before a new store. Upkeep of 2 hours covers feature names.
The class is human. The visit share stays with the agent.
unknowns: What share of showings are commercial rather than residential.
Whether clients already receive the sheet by mail.
research_questions: How often does the agent cross out a feature on the sheet during the visit?

incremental.description: Add feature names the office has started using

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every showing is different and the sheet is barely used. High: the sheet is ready and the showing itself stays at full length.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Signing day, seminars, client answers and showings stay. Checklists and sheets are ready beforehand, and the agent can hold a waiver, a market point or a feature the sheet got wrong.
reach: Real estate brokers: say which missing closing document, market point or feature claim an agent may not carry alone
skills_to_grow: Reading a closing checklist without treating disbursement as the agent's job
Refusing a financing answer that belongs to another profession
Crossing out a feature the building does not have
role.ambitious_version: A signing starts from a checklist with an owner on every open document, and a showing starts from a sheet the agent has corrected.
